_what: Which tuning-panel widget sets one tool input (made-controls.mjs `derivedRow`). `rules` are tried in order; the first whose `when` holds for the facts of the input's schema chooses `widget`, and `with` names what the row carries beside its key and label: `integer` (whether the input is a whole number), `options` (its enum as choices, null left out), `item_options` (its items' enum, for a list), `range` (its minimum and maximum, each when it has one), `step` (a hundredth of the range, a power of ten, 1 for a whole number), `default` (its default, when it has one) and `default_or_false` (its default, else false). The facts (made-controls.mjs `fieldFacts`) are `numeric`, `integer`, `has_range`, `has_enum`, `enum_count`, `boolean`, `items_enum` and `words` (a string, or a choice of types one of which is a string); `holds` is the view-of-a-value rule check (tools/ui/show/view-of-a-value/project.mjs), so `*_lte`/`*_gte` bound a number. An input no row holds for has no control a person sets by hand. The same facts choose a part in a chat view (view-of-a-value.json `input_rules`).
